title: Core's push policy admits the task queue's refs/abandoned records
goal: Vision: V-9. Found while clearing the orphaned reservation by CEO direction 2026-11-16: core's pre-push policy admits the queue's metadata blobs (refs/claims, refs/claim-agents, refs/claim-generation, refs/closed) but not refs/abandoned, the record of why an accepted task was given up. So tasks release --abandon failed in every core checkout, on laptops too, with unsupported ref namespace. Admit refs/abandoned as the same kind of blob, and pin it in the policy's test.
limitations: Admits the namespace on the local transport check only; whether the remote accepts the push is the remote's own decision (a cloud session's storage refuses it).
Main is unqualified development, not a release.
